image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade baby bib lying on a white textured surface (likely a blanket). The bib features a white central panel with vertical pleats or tucks, bordered by light blue ruffled lace trim. A diagonal sash of pink fabric with large white and smaller green polka dots crosses the front. The neck opening is curved and also trimmed with the blue lace. Ties or fasteners are not clearly visible in this specific crop, but the construction suggests a soft fabric item.
